about_the_game:
Try the Delve Down Under DEMO and get a taste of frantic, Aussie-themed bullet hell rogue-lite action!

Get a first look at the unfolding nightmare! Deep beneath Uluru, reckless Nazi occultists have tampered with the Dreamtime, unleashing chaos. This free demo throws you right into the first act of the game: the corrupted Uluru Underground Base. Choose your warrior – the aggressive cockatoo Chippy or the sharpshooting koala Kylie – both empowered by ancient magic, and prepare to fight through the initial wave of twisted abominations spilling from the rift.

In this demo, you'll experience the core gameplay loop: blast, slash, and dodge your way through procedurally generated rooms within the first act's environment. Master the fast-paced, challenging bullet hell combat against a sample of the bizarre Nazi-animal hybrids and warped wildlife found in the early game. Utilize the strategic map system to navigate between different encounter types available in this preview build, and experiment with a selection of weapons, items, and perks to get a feel for the build possibilities and survive the demo's challenges!

What's Included in this DEMO:

  • Play the First Act: Battle through the procedurally generated rooms of the Uluru Underground Base environment and face its unique challenges and boss encounter.

  • Two Playable Heroes: Master the distinct playstyles of Chippy the Cockatoo (Colt 1911 & Machete) and Kylie the Koala (Bolt-Action Rifle & Dodge Roll).

  • A Sample Arsenal: Discover and wield a curated selection of 12 unique guns, 8 powerful items, and 12 game-changing perks to experiment with different builds within the demo.

  • Core Rogue-lite Map: Navigate the strategic map featuring 7 different room types: Basic Combat, Elite Combat, Boss Encounter, Shop, Campsite, Treasure Room, and Key Room.

  • Early Game Enemies: Encounter a diverse sample of the twisted Aussie wildlife and Nazi-animal hybrid abominations specific to the first act.

Important Demo Information:

  • No Persistent Saves: Progress made during a run in this demo is not saved between sessions and does not carry over to the full game. Each playthrough is a fresh run.

  • Language Support: This demo is currently available in English only. Features and languages available in the full Early Access game may differ.

Download the Delve Down Under DEMO today to experience the core combat, explore the unique setting, and see if you have what it takes to face the nightmare! If you enjoy the action, please consider wishlisting the game providing feedback in the Discord community.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 / 8 / 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: A basic PC from the last decade should be able to run the game without issues.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 7850 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Higher refresh rate monitors and SSDs will improve gameplay smoothness.

short_description: Delve Down Under is a bullet hell rogue-lite set in wartime Australia, 1941. Play as mutated Aussie heroes battling Nazi occult forces and Dreamtime horrors. Dodge, shoot, and slash through chaotic combat, collect powerful relics, and strategize your way through procedurally generated dungeon runs.
